nodes.label: Cart Page (/cart)
nodes.rationale: Quantity changes use a 500ms debounce plus an inFlight ref guard to stop duplicate PATCH calls while keeping optimistic UI updates; empty state renders EmptyCart with a continue-shopping link, and the order summary shows subtotal/free shipping/total with a /checkout CTA.

nodes.label: session_id Cookie Persistent Cart
nodes.rationale: Cookie-based session_id issued by proxy.ts keeps the cart for 30 days without requiring login, so guests do not lose their cart.

nodes.label: carts Table (CART-DATA)
nodes.rationale: items stored as jsonb with an index on session_id; 30-day TTL judged from updated_at and purged by a cleanup job.

nodes.label: Coupon Validation Design (CART-COUPON)
nodes.rationale: One code, single use, no stacking. Validation and discounted total are recomputed server-side because client-submitted values are never trusted.

nodes.label: Cart Stock Check (cart-stock.ts)
nodes.rationale: Aggregated quantity per item_id validated against stock_quantity; unpublished items and stock shortfalls return 409.

nodes.label: Stripe CheckoutProvider + PaymentElement
nodes.rationale: Card entry is delegated entirely to Stripe hosted Elements so no card data ever reaches the app server, keeping the integration PCI DSS compliant.

nodes.label: POST /api/checkout/create-session
nodes.rationale: Checks stock_quantity before payment and returns 409 with an out-of-stock message, so a session is never created for unavailable inventory.

nodes.label: POST /api/checkout/complete
nodes.rationale: checkoutSessionId and draft_id are mandatory so the public complete endpoint only finalizes an order after verifying the Stripe session.

nodes.label: Checkout Draft Snapshot
nodes.rationale: An immutable draft is persisted at create-session time and finalize_order_from_checkout_draft RPC builds the order only from that snapshot, so client values cannot alter the order.

nodes.label: Stripe Webhook (/api/webhook/stripe)
nodes.rationale: Also owns confirmation-mail delivery; the SendGrid template integration is still unimplemented.

nodes.label: Webhook Idempotency Design
nodes.rationale: Signature verify -> INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING -> worker SELECT FOR UPDATE, with exponential backoff and DLQ, so retried or replayed Stripe events never create duplicate orders.

nodes.label: orders Table (CHECKOUT-DATA)
nodes.rationale: user_id nullable to allow guest orders; total_amount stored as JPY integer and always recomputed server-side rather than trusting the client.

nodes.label: postal_code_cache + Postal Lookup API
nodes.rationale: Cached postal codes are served from the table so the external address API is not re-invoked on a hit.

nodes.label: Event Schema Versioning (INTEG-EVENT)
nodes.rationale: v1 is frozen against breaking changes; additive optional fields allowed, type changes or removals require a new version. Schemas kept in OpenAPI/JSON Schema and diffed in CI.

nodes.label: API Versioning Policy (INTEG-APIVER)
nodes.rationale: Version in URL path or Accept header; incompatible changes ship as a new version with a minimum 6-month deprecation window signalled by Deprecation/Sunset headers.

nodes.label: Secret Rotation Policy (INTEG-SECRETS)
nodes.rationale: 90-day routine rotation for Stripe and Supabase keys; suspected leak forces rotation within 1 hour via Secrets Manager -> CI/CD -> rolling deploy -> health check -> revoke old.

nodes.label: LoginModal Component
nodes.rationale: Resend is gated by a countdown timer so repeated presses cannot spam mail delivery.

nodes.label: Email OTP Passwordless Flow
nodes.rationale: Existing and new users are handled uniformly by the OTP flow (JIT user creation), which is why a dedicated signup page was marked WONT for this phase.

nodes.label: Google OAuth Login (AUTH-02)
nodes.rationale: Switched to Supabase signInWithOAuth because hand-rolled state/PKCE passed to /auth/v1/authorize conflicted with Supabase's own state management (bad_oauth_state). prompt=select_account forces the Google account chooser.

nodes.label: oauth_requests Table (state/PKCE)
nodes.rationale: 10-minute TTL with used_at/expires_at replay detection and a periodic cleanup job; Redis is the preferred store, Postgres the fallback.

nodes.label: OAuth Callback Route
nodes.rationale: Code is exchanged server-side and a 303 clean-URL redirect is issued so the authorization code never lingers in the browser URL.

nodes.label: OAuth Account Collision Policy
nodes.rationale: Auto-merge is rejected for the initial implementation because it raises account-takeover risk; users must explicitly approve linking via link-proposal with re-authentication.

nodes.label: Supabase Auth Integration Design (SUPA-DESIGN)
nodes.rationale: Supabase Auth is used only as the identity store; session, CSRF, rate limiting and audit policy stay in the app so security behaviour is not constrained by the vendor.

nodes.label: Session JTI Rotation & Reuse Detection
nodes.rationale: A JTI mismatch on refresh implies a stolen refresh token, so the session is quarantined and all sessions revoked. Concurrent sessions are capped at 5 per user with the oldest auto-evicted rather than blocking new logins.

nodes.label: Password Reset Flow
nodes.rationale: The mail link is consumed immediately by a server route and swapped for an HttpOnly reset-session cookie plus clean URL, so the token never persists in browser history.

nodes.label: RLS Policy Application (migration 013)
nodes.rationale: Anon key can be exposed publicly only because RLS protects the tables; service-role-only tables include sessions, audit_logs, oauth_requests and token tables.

nodes.label: SES Registration Mail Integration
nodes.rationale: Supabase's built-in confirm mail cannot be branded, so tokens move to an app-owned email_confirmation_tokens table (migration 012) delivered via SES.

nodes.label: Token/Session Cleanup Cron Jobs
nodes.rationale: Vercel Cron endpoints guarded by CRON_SECRET run daily at 02:00/03:00 UTC to purge expired tokens and revoked sessions after 30 days.

nodes.label: Token Lifetime Policy
nodes.rationale: Access 15 min, refresh 7 days sliding to 30 max, password reset 1 hour, email confirmation 24 hours — short-lived access limits blast radius while sliding refresh preserves UX.

nodes.label: Account Page (/account)
nodes.rationale: Tab state is synced to the ?tab= query and legacy ?tab=address normalizes to shipping; the shipping tab owns address only (autocompleted via /api/checkout/postal-code) while the profile tab owns email/name/kana/phone, and order history links to /account/orders/[id].

nodes.label: Profile API (/api/profile)
nodes.rationale: Resolves the user from a Bearer token or sb-access-token cookie because the client login state diverged from supabase.auth.getUser() when only the custom auth cookie was present.

nodes.label: profiles Table (kana_name/phone/address)
nodes.rationale: profiles is RLS-protected, so account APIs forward the request Authorization header to the Supabase client and run queries in the user's context.

nodes.label: Admin Page (/admin)
nodes.rationale: visibleTabs is computed with useMemo and re-checked inside renderContent, a deliberate double check so a role cannot reach a NEWS/ITEM/LOOK/STOCKIST/USER/ORDER/KPI tab by bypassing the nav.

nodes.label: RBAC Permission Matrix (ADMIN-RBAC)
nodes.rationale: supporter is denied refunds, coupon creation, role changes and audit-log viewing; enforcement is duplicated at the Supabase RLS layer keyed on the acl_roles role column.

nodes.label: ORDER Management Tab
nodes.rationale: Pagination is server-side at pageSize=20 but keyword/status filtering is client-side over the current page only, so full-catalog search is not supported.

nodes.label: Admin Audit Log Schema & Retention
nodes.rationale: 1 year hot for incident/compliance search and 7 years cold archive for legal and accounting; stored immutably with periodic hash integrity checks and instant alerts on privileged actions.

nodes.label: Admin Onboarding & Mandatory 2FA
nodes.rationale: Least privilege first: supporter-level access is granted initially and promoted to admin only after work is verified; all admin-role users are blocked until TOTP 2FA is enabled.

nodes.label: Privacy Policy Page (/privacy)
nodes.rationale: Kept as an RSC with generateMetadata in the same file; E2E is split into content and metadata specs so layout breakage and missing meta are detected independently.

nodes.label: Search Page (/search?q=)
nodes.rationale: q and tab are URL-synced across ALL/ITEM/LOOK/NEWS; zero results show a query-specific message plus popular items, and localStorage search.history feeds return-visit suggestions.

nodes.label: Search API (/api/search)
nodes.rationale: Currently ilike-based partial matching; NFR is P95 < 200ms, which local runs do not yet meet, so the perf spec is under fixme.

nodes.label: Search Architecture (SEARCH-ARCH)
nodes.rationale: Supabase tsvector+GIN is the primary backend with Meilisearch/Algolia held as a scale-up option; the DB is the source of truth because index stock values lag and must never be used for order-time validation.

nodes.label: Nightly Index Reconciliation (SEARCH-RECONCILE)
nodes.rationale: Diffs above 1% of stock or 10 absolute units are flagged for auto-correction, but order and reservation logs are consulted first so corrections cannot overwrite live activity.

nodes.label: SLO Targets (latency/LCP/availability)
nodes.rationale: API P95 < 200ms, LCP P95 < 2.5s, availability 99.5%; none are measured yet because benchmarking and Core Web Vitals collection are unbuilt.

nodes.label: CI Quality Gate (QA-CI)
nodes.rationale: Merge requires Lint+Unit+Integration+Contract green; E2E is only recommended pre-merge because it runs against staging, and High security findings need a tracked remediation ticket rather than blocking.

nodes.label: Monitoring Architecture Candidates
nodes.source_location: 監視アーキテクチャ候補
nodes.rationale: Vercel Analytics + Sentry for APM, Prometheus/Grafana or Datadog for metrics, OpenTelemetry to Jaeger/Zipkin for traces, Vercel Speed Insights or web-vitals for RUM.

nodes.label: Trace Naming Convention (TRACE-NAMING)
nodes.rationale: {component}.{resource}.{operation} in lowercase dot notation, with a per-request trace-id joining logs and metrics for observability.

nodes.label: CI/CD Pipeline & Canary/Blue-Green (OPS-CICD)
nodes.rationale: Canary at 5% production auto-rolls back when error rate exceeds 1% for 5 minutes, before Blue-Green promotion to 100%.

nodes.label: Log Retention Policy (OPS-LOG)
nodes.rationale: 30 days high-resolution, 1 year aggregated, 7 years audit; audit logs go to WORM storage or hash signing to prevent tampering.

nodes.label: Incident Runbook (OPS-RUNBOOK)
nodes.rationale: Detect -> scope -> rollback -> notify -> postmortem within 48 hours, with daily/weekly/monthly standing checks.

nodes.label: Supabase Service Role Key Rotation Flow
nodes.source_location: Supabase Service Role Key 運用フロー
nodes.rationale: Key lives only in AWS Secrets Manager fetched by IAM role; emergency rotation accepts a brief connection cutoff to contain a suspected leak, followed by CloudTrail forensics.

nodes.label: Design Tokens (Tailwind/CSS vars)
nodes.rationale: Still Tailwind defaults; brand-guideline color tokens are not yet reflected.

nodes.label: UI Component Library (src/components/ui)
nodes.rationale: All Form/Nav/Overlay/Data Display/Feedback components ship with a uiSizeClass sm/md/lg size token, are previewed at /ui, and are shared via PublicItemGrid/PublicLookGrid/PublicNewsGrid/PublicStockistGrid on Home and the list pages. Storybook remains unimplemented.

nodes.label: ESLint Barrel Import Ban
nodes.rationale: Importing @/components/ui as a barrel is forbidden by ESLint to force direct per-component imports.

nodes.label: Tech Stack (TECH-STACK)
nodes.rationale: Next.js App Router + TypeScript strict, Tailwind v4, Supabase (Postgres/Auth/RLS), Stripe Checkout Sessions, Zod, Jest/RTL, Playwright, GitHub Actions.

nodes.label: Feature-Based src/ Structure
nodes.rationale: app/components/contexts/features/hooks/lib/styles/types split; globals.css moved to styles/, Cart/Login contexts consolidated to contexts/, and app/types dependency removed.

nodes.label: Environment Variable Management
nodes.rationale: .env.local holds secrets locally and .env.example documents required vars; TRUSTED_PROXY_IPS is planned so proxied client IPs can be validated safely.

nodes.label: Terraform Module Design (INFRA-TERRAFORM)
nodes.rationale: Remote backend mandatory with per-environment state split; staging and production share modules and differ only by variables, and secrets are marked sensitive and sourced from Secrets Manager.

nodes.label: OpenAPI & Contract Testing (INFRA-OPENAPI)
nodes.rationale: OpenAPI YAML is the source of truth for public APIs, generates client SDKs, and CI diffs the spec to block breaking changes; external APIs are pinned by contract tests.
